topic.angle: Hearing your own name in a noisy room

card.title: You hear your name across the room

body.claim: In a noisy room, your brain can follow one conversation and still notice some messages from elsewhere, like your own name.
body.why: The cocktail party effect is a phenomenon wherein the brain focuses a person's attention on a particular stimulus, usually auditory. Examples of messages that catch people's attention include personal names and taboo words.

probes.question: True or false: personal names are among the messages that catch people's attention in a noisy room.
The cocktail party effect is mostly about which sense?

image_brief.show: A crowded, lively party or cafe with many people talking
